lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills, arranged in a grid-like formation of at least three horizontal rows and five vertical columns within the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity aligned with the circular centroids, creating a visual grid where intersections act as anchor nodes for the primary spotting pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features along the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with light-exposed upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of micro-spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin and the cranial region.
